name: @caotang/import-epub
description: The EPUB reader for the EPUB import (#296): container.xml to the OPF, its metadata, manifest and spine, the EPUB 3 nav or the EPUB 2 NCX for chapter titles and fragments, and the shared XHTML walker for the text. Landmarks become front or back matter, footnotes become [^n], the cover and pictures are kept, and a DRM file is refused. No DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
